mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students (student_id, password, name, grade, class_name, class_number, register_year, total_coupon, total_point, created_date) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{grade}, #{className}, #{classNumber}, YEAR(NOW()), 0, 100000, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT name, grade, class_name, class_number, total_point, password FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY MAX(total_point) DESC, student_id ASC) AS `rank`, student_id AS studentId, MAX(name) AS name, MAX(grade) AS grade, MAX(class_name) AS className, MAX(class_number) AS classNumber, MAX(total_point) AS totalPoint FROM students GROUP BY student_id ORDER BY MAX(total_point) DESC, student_id ASC LIMIT 100
